lemmas.primary_translation: meddle in something that does not concern one

definitions.text: blande seg opp i noe som ikke angår en
definitions.translation: meddle in something that does not concern one (lit. stick one's nose into something)

examples.no: jeg vil nødig stikke nesa i andres saker
